settings.title: Ask within 7 days
settings.text: Open your tracking page (the link in your shipping SMS or email, or the button below) and choose Return. Want a different size? Pick "Size not as expected" and tell us the size you'd like.

settings.title: We confirm
settings.text: We check the request against the conditions below and let you know by SMS or email.

settings.title: Courier collects
settings.text: A courier picks the tee up from your door. Keep it folded with the tags on, ready to hand over.

settings.title: New size or refund
settings.text: Once it reaches us, we ship the new size or refund you — to your original payment method within 5-7 business days.
Unworn and unwashed, free of stains, odours and pet hair
All original tags still attached, in its original packaging
Damaged or wrong item? Tell us within 48 hours of delivery with a photo, and we'll put it right at no cost to you

settings.intro: Kids grow faster than anyone plans for. If a tee doesn't fit, you have 7 days from delivery to send it back or swap the size.
settings.help_text: Use the tracking link in your shipping SMS or email. Can't find it? Write to us with your order number and we'll start it for you.
